name: Crack a fetch for an untapped shockland when no Mountain is up
intent: Crack Arid Mesa, Flooded Strand or Marsh Flats on my precombat main for an untapped shockland carrying Mountain (red for Ragavan and Galvanic Discharge) when no untapped land of mine carries that type, paying 2 life because that colour is actually missing. If Mountain is up, fetch-untapped-shock-second-color checks Plains. It prefers a shock with Mountain, then a basic Mountain, then any basic, so with no such shock in reach it takes a free basic rather than paying for a colour that is up. Only at 8 life or more, because the fetch plus the shock costs 3 and this deck races, and only while a shock with Mountain is still in my library. With Mountain and Plains all up no fetch play fires: every colour a shock would give is already available, and fetching a basic or holding the fetch is the pilot's call. Limits: a colour counts as up only from an untapped land with its basic land type, so Arena of Glory's red, Dalkovan Encampment's white and mana creatures are not seen, and this can pay for a colour they already make; one play cannot say that any one of several colours is missing, hence one play per colour; and a library count cannot tell which fetch gets cracked, which is why the pick falls back to basics.
